firm_data.firm_description: Kaye Scholer's Diane Holt Frankle has led corporate mergers and acquisitions deals over the last 25 years that have a total value of more than $12 billion. She is an expert in advising public companies, technology startups, and companies in the health care field on M&A and other corporate board-related matters.
notable_facts: Diane Holt Frankle has led corporate mergers and acquisitions deals over the last 25 years that have a total value of more than $12 billion.
Diane Holt Frankle was chair of the ABA’s subcommittee on public company acquisitions and the editor of the ABA’s Model Merger Agreement for the Acquisition of a Public Company (2011).
Diane Holt Frankle served as chair of the State Bar of California’s Business Law Section Corporations Committee (1993–94).
